spec.description: Live operations view of channel health: viewers, startup, rebuffering, bitrate, latency, and errors.

spec.rawSql: SELECT uniqMerge(viewers_state) AS viewers FROM analytics.analytics_concurrent_viewers WHERE minute = (SELECT max(minute) FROM analytics.analytics_concurrent_viewers WHERE minute <= toDateTime($__toTime) AND content_id IN (${channel:singlequote}) AND platform IN (${platform:singlequote})) AND content_id IN (${channel:singlequote}) AND platform IN (${platform:singlequote})

SELECT round(avg(startup_time_ms),0) AS avg_startup_ms FROM analytics.analytics_sessions WHERE session_date BETWEEN toDate(toDateTime($__fromTime)) AND toDate(toDateTime($__toTime)) AND content_id IN (${channel:singlequote}) AND platform IN (${platform:singlequote})

SELECT round(100 * sum(rebuffer_time_s) / nullIf(sum(watch_time_s), 0), 3) AS rebuffer_ratio_pct FROM analytics.analytics_sessions WHERE session_date BETWEEN toDate(toDateTime($__fromTime)) AND toDate(toDateTime($__toTime)) AND content_id IN (${channel:singlequote}) AND platform IN (${platform:singlequote})

spec.title: Bitrate and bandwidth over time
spec.description: Average player bitrate and bandwidth estimate in Mbps.

spec.rawSql: SELECT event_minute AS time, round(avg(current_bitrate_kbps) / 1000, 3) AS bitrate_mbps, round(avg(bandwidth_estimate_kbps) / 1000, 3) AS bandwidth_mbps FROM analytics.analytics_heartbeats WHERE event_minute BETWEEN toDateTime($__fromTime) AND toDateTime($__toTime) AND content_id IN (${channel:singlequote}) AND platform IN (${platform:singlequote}) GROUP BY event_minute ORDER BY event_minute

spec.title: Errors over time
spec.description: Errors grouped by source and code.

spec.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(toDateTime(intDiv(timestamp, 1000))) AS time, concat(error_source, ': ', error_code) AS error, count() AS errors FROM analytics.analytics_errors WHERE timestamp BETWEEN (toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime) * 1000) AND (toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) * 1000) AND content_id IN (${channel:singlequote}) AND platform IN (${platform:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, error ORDER BY time

SELECT round(avg(current_bitrate_kbps)/1000,3) AS avg_bitrate_mbps FROM analytics.analytics_heartbeats WHERE event_minute BETWEEN toDateTime($__fromTime) AND toDateTime($__toTime) AND content_id IN (${channel:singlequote}) AND platform IN (${platform:singlequote})

SELECT round(avg(live_latency_s),3) AS avg_latency_s FROM analytics.analytics_heartbeats WHERE event_minute BETWEEN toDateTime($__fromTime) AND toDateTime($__toTime) AND content_id IN (${channel:singlequote}) AND platform IN (${platform:singlequote})

spec.title: Live viewers by channel over time

spec.rawSql: SELECT minute AS time, content_id, uniqMerge(viewers_state) AS viewers FROM analytics.analytics_concurrent_viewers WHERE minute BETWEEN toDateTime($__fromTime) AND toDateTime($__toTime) AND content_id IN (${channel:singlequote}) AND platform IN (${platform:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, content_id ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(toDateTime(intDiv(session_start_ts,1000))) AS time, avg(startup_time_ms) AS avg_startup_ms, quantile(0.95)(startup_time_ms) AS p95_startup_ms FROM analytics.analytics_sessions WHERE session_start_ts BETWEEN (toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime) * 1000) AND (toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) * 1000) AND content_id IN (${channel:singlequote}) AND platform IN (${platform:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_minute) AS time, avg(live_latency_s) AS avg_latency_s, quantile(0.95)(live_latency_s) AS p95_latency_s FROM analytics.analytics_heartbeats WHERE event_minute BETWEEN toDateTime($__fromTime) AND toDateTime($__toTime) AND content_id IN (${channel:singlequote}) AND platform IN (${platform:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

spec.title: Buffer health
spec.description: Average buffer length and buffering share.

spec.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_minute) AS time, avg(buffer_length_s) AS avg_buffer_s, avg(is_buffering) * 100 AS buffering_pct FROM analytics.analytics_heartbeats WHERE event_minute BETWEEN toDateTime($__fromTime) AND toDateTime($__toTime) AND content_id IN (${channel:singlequote}) AND platform IN (${platform:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

spec.title: Current channel health
spec.description: Per-channel bitrate, latency, buffer and active sessions in the selected range.

spec.rawSql: SELECT content_id, round(avg(current_bitrate_kbps)/1000,3) AS bitrate_mbps, round(avg(live_latency_s),3) AS latency_s, round(avg(buffer_length_s),3) AS buffer_s, uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions FROM analytics.analytics_heartbeats WHERE event_minute BETWEEN toDateTime($__fromTime) AND toDateTime($__toTime) AND content_id IN (${channel:singlequote}) AND platform IN (${platform:singlequote}) GROUP BY content_id ORDER BY content_id

spec.title: Latest completed sessions
spec.description: Sessions with a SESSION_END event in the selected time range.

spec.rawSql: SELECT s.session_end, s.content_id, s.content_title, s.platform, s.viewer_id, s.session_id, ip.client_ip, s.watch_time_s, s.startup_time_ms, s.session_end_reason FROM (SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(session_end_ts,1000)) AS session_end, content_id, content_title, platform, viewer_id, session_id, round(watch_time_s,0) AS watch_time_s, startup_time_ms, session_end_reason FROM analytics.analytics_sessions WHERE session_end_ts BETWEEN (toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime) * 1000) AND (toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) * 1000) AND content_id IN (${channel:singlequote}) AND platform IN (${platform:singlequote})) AS s LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id, any(client_ip) AS client_ip FROM analytics.analytics_events GROUP BY session_id) AS ip ON s.session_id = ip.session_id WHERE (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR s.session_id ILIKE concat('%', ${search:sqlstring}, '%') OR s.viewer_id ILIKE concat('%', ${search:sqlstring}, '%') OR ip.client_ip ILIKE concat('%', ${search:sqlstring}, '%')) ORDER BY s.session_end DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT count() AS errors FROM analytics.analytics_errors WHERE timestamp BETWEEN (toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime) * 1000) AND (toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) * 1000) AND content_id IN (${channel:singlequote}) AND platform IN (${platform:singlequote})

spec.title: Video QoE Live Operations

spec.name: search
spec.label: Search (session/viewer/IP)
spec.description: Filters the Latest completed sessions table by session ID, viewer ID, or client IP.
